name: gemini
description: Google Gemini provider module: generateContent model routing across the gemini-2.5-flash (flash-class) and gemini-2.5-pro (pro-class) tiers over the Generative Language API, with per-deployment (Vertex AI) override and cloud-to-local (Ollama) graceful degradation.

features.desc: Generative Language generateContent chat with x-goog-api-key auth, systemInstruction lifting and typed output validation.
LOW/MED route to gemini-2.5-flash, HIGH/MAX to gemini-2.5-pro, chosen from the issue-#9 tier ladder.
A Vertex AI deployment is reached by overriding base_url and extra_headers in the provider config (the harvested per-deployment override approach).
Cloud-to-local fallback to the keyless local Ollama hop when the primary is unavailable.

provenance.harvested_from: kushin77/gov-ai-scout backend/src/services/ai-provider.ts; kushin77/capital-underwriting (Gemini per-deployment client, model constants)
provenance.note: Gateway-owned module-catalog entry (issue #349) for the registered `gemini` provider adapter. Pattern only; the provider-gateway shape and the per-deployment override approach were re-implemented for this repo's Python substrate, no source file was copied.
